description: Explicit subset-product instance for a Baillie-PSW counterexample (D = 5, class (1,2)). Any S subset of 'primes' with |S| >= 3, prod(S) == 1 mod L1 and prod(S) == -1 mod L2 gives a composite n = prod(S) passing strong BPSW. |S| is then odd because 3 | L2 and every listed prime is == -1 mod 3. Proof in src/pom/instance.py. No listed prime divides L1*L2. Augmented with 964 further primes fitting the same moduli (src/pom/fit.py).
